raft-wars-2.title: Raft Wars 2: Defend Your Treasure in Epic Battles
raft-wars-2.slogan: Join Simon and His Brother in Their Quest to Protect the Treasure
raft-wars-2.description: Raft Wars 2 brings you an exciting physics-based adventure where Simon and his brother must defend their hidden treasure from invaders. With a realistic physics engine, you can aim, adjust, and launch tennis balls to knock down enemies and earn points. Upgrade your weapons and raft to enhance your battle strategy. Ready to take on the challenge? Play Raft Wars 2 now and experience the thrill of defending your treasure!
